text:
Nina (Design): Quick review request: we added a small modal when users opt into session recording for debugging. Need copy + accessibility check. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/snap/recording-consent.png

Current copy draft: Header="Enable session recording?" Body="To help diagnose issues, we'll record console logs and request payloads for your session. Recordings are stored encrypted for 30 days." Primary="Enable recording" Secondary="Not now"

Ethan (Privacy): A couple of legaly/usability notes: be explicit about where recordings go (org-only vs support access). Mention opt-out ability later. Also we should surface a link to the privacy policy and a short bullets list of what's captured (console logs, network requests, user-entered prompts — but not system secrets).

Roshni (A11y): Microcopy suggestions: "Enable session recording" is actionable but for screen readers header-question + action is odd. Suggest header: "Record this session for debugging?" and primary button: "Record session". Make secondary: "No thanks" instead of "Not now" so it's clear and not ambiguous about timing. Also ensure modal has role="dialog" and aria-describedby points to the bullet list.

Marco (ENG): Implementation detail: backend flags recording and stores metadata. We can show org-only visibility vs support-readable based on the flag. I can also toggle the 30-day retention string dynamically.

Nina (Design): Revised microcopy proposal: Header: "Record this session for debugging?" Body: "We will capture console logs and request/response data to help diagnose issues. Recordings are encrypted and retained for {{retention}} days. Who can view: \u2014 Your org admins; \u2014 Redwood Support (with your approval)." CTAs: primary "Record session" secondary "No thanks" Links: "Privacy & data handling"

Ethan (Privacy): Prefer: "Only your org's admins can view recordings by default. Contact support to share recordings externally." Also add consent tracking: store explicit consent timestamp and user id. For the body, avoid listing anything that sounds like we capture user content; instead say "non-sensitive request/response metadata and logs" and link to full policy.

Roshni (A11y): A few notes: 1) Add an aria-live polite region for confirmation after enabling: "Recording enabled. You can stop recording from the session menu." 2) For the CTAs, place them DOM-primary-first. 3) Provide visually-hidden extra context: "You can revoke consent at any time; recordings will be deleted according to retention policy." 4) If we show bullets, mark them as <ul aria-hidden=\"false\"> and ensure screen reader reads them by linking via aria-describedby.

Nina (Design): Tone check: keep calm, short sentences, avoid legalese in the modal copy. Copy candidates for the small bullets: "What we capture: console logs, request metadata, response statuses." "What we do not capture: secret keys or masked fields." Keep those short.

Marco (ENG): I'll expose flags for viewers and retention to the frontend and ensure the confirm button writes consent to the audit log. Also will add banner after enabling: "Recording on: click to stop" with accessible toggle.

Ethan (Privacy): One more: add a short inline tooltip for admins explaining how to download or delete recordings and link to admin docs. For the modal copy, remove the word "payloads" 1 sounds too technical.

Roshni (A11y): Recommend text adjustments: primary button text: "Start recording" (present-tense verb), secondary: "No thanks". Confirmation announcement example: aria-live: "Session recording started. Press the session menu to stop recording." Also ensure focus moves into the modal and returns to trigger after close.

Nina (Design): Final candidate set I'll put into the PR: Header: "Record this session for debugging?" Body: "We will securely capture console logs and request/response metadata to help diagnose issues. Recordings are encrypted and retained for {{retention}} days. Only your org's admins can view recordings by default." Bullets: two short bullets for what we capture / don't capture. Primary CTA: "Start recording" Secondary CTA: "No thanks" Links: "Privacy & data handling" (opens docs).

Marco (ENG): Sounds good. I'll make the modal accessible (role/dialog, aria-describedby, focus trap), hook up consent audit event, and add the banner toggle. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/5123

build-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-internal/mock/session-recording/v1 (expires in 72h) :rocket:

Roshni (A11y): I'll review the PR for the focus behavior and live region announcements once it's up. Quick nit: prefer "Stop recording" label on the banner toggle rather than "Disable".

Ethan (Privacy): Will sign off on the copy once the final text references the policy link and consent logging.

Nina (Design): Thanks all 1 will update the design file with the final copy and include the sr-only snippets. Merging when PR gets approvals. :sparkles:
